description: Synthetic engineering inputs only. No fixture URI supplies media; the adapter is not a real H3 deployment.

official-base.excerpt: Base modes T2VA/I2VA/FL2VA/L2VA have three fields and exact image-alignment lines.

official-ref.excerpt: Ref2VA has six fields, independent reference categories and explicit audio retention relationships.

fixture-plan.excerpt: Synthetic engineering test declarations; the URI strings do not identify supplied real media and no H3 capability is inferred.

synthetic-runtime.excerpt: Synthetic object-only adapter: /request/prompt contains the full rendered protocol text including any alignment first line; /request/mode, /request/media is an ordered list of {value,channel,label,input_index} objects; /request/seconds, /request/width, /request/height and /request/fps. This is not a MiniMax API or a real workflow.
